text:
Joel Farabee has found a home on Calgary's top line, at least by the minutes: 19 a night, the most of his career, with 17 points in 18 games and 7 goals in his last ten. He scored shorthanded in the overtime win over Philadelphia on Sunday, against the team that drafted him 14th overall in 2018.

The shooting is honest. His 7 goals come on 6.7 expected, so he is finishing about where his chances say he should. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 61% of his shots coming off the rush last season, and that is still how he scores: first few seconds after a turnover, going the other way.

The part that will cool is around him. Calgary has scored 5.4 more goals than its chances deserve with Farabee on the ice, which has padded his assist total. Our projection lands near 59 points, a big step past anything he did in Philadelphia but short of his current pace. The goals look sustainable. Some of the helpers don't.
headline: Farabee is earning his minutes in Calgary
